Question: As salaam, Dear Respected Mufti Sahaab, What if someone did not take his deen seriously and broke around 400 fasts intentionally over the years? Does that mean i have to keep 24000 days of consecutive fasts? Or am I grossly misunderstanding something? Please help, i am really worried now as i am taking my deen seriously, is another way to repent as it is very diffcult. Answer ID: 16563 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1601/1483/B=1430) He should give one kaffrah for all the years i.e. feed sixty poor persons two times meals. Do not commit such act again and fear Allah. Also, you have to perform qadha of the fasts you broke. It is to be noted that the ruling of feeding sixty people will be applied only when he is unable to fast for sixty consecutive days. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
